external_observations.evidence_span: Absolutely worst attitude, no will to fix problems just money money … The worst experience I am glad I left the apartment already …They are keep sending me facturation for apartment I am not living in anymore and last week before I left there was no hot water in apartment wich has been marked as Fikset the same day I left 🫣🤣 Just avoid them and save yourself lot of nerves 🙏

external_observations.label: neutral
external_observations.evidence_span:
Jaw-droppingly beautiful reception area with glass walls, beautifully coordinated seating areas, cloak room and innovative design features.

There is also a mesmerizing screen wall with realistic looking nature scenes.

I don't know if it is open to the public generally but the place is so beautiful it is worth checking out if you have some excuse.

external_observations.label: neutral
external_observations.evidence_span: Uses APCOA /Riverty collections to manage parking at Sandstuveien. APCOA and Riverty collections are some of the most predatory parking companies around. If you are a business owner and have an interest in renting or allowing them to manage your property remember your customer base.

external_observations.label: neutral
external_observations.evidence_span: I understand that your company dont want any negative review, but take it seriously, when people get accused for rasism that is a terrible accuse. After that you decide to delete the review show that the comany dont stand for what your employees say. What happened in the past can stay in the past. What happend now can stay. I dont recommend anybody to use this company, just stay away from em.
